companyFieldUpdates.description: Strategic Venue Partners designs, finances, owns, operates and upgrades neutral-host in-building wireless infrastructure under long-term venue contracts. The platform's assets include distributed antenna systems, public-safety networks, private LTE/CBRS, Wi-Fi and fiber serving healthcare, hospitality, education, entertainment, retail, real-estate and data-center venues. SVP launched in 2017 and formed a holding company in January 2019 to consolidate its infrastructure assets. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund II records 2019 as its entry year and remains the controlling sponsor. Brookfield Asset Management and institutional partners completed a minority equity investment through Brookfield Infrastructure Structured Solutions on December 11, 2024; the exact percentage, security and holding SPVs are not publicly disclosed. A March 2025 refinancing reconfirmed Tiger control and Brookfield's minority position, and no later owner transfer or signed exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
